author: Codex
design_lineage: ChatGPT Pro PR12 target-order diagnostic handoff
sole_changed_variable: Within each epoch, permute all 212 original training teacher-prefix/target occurrences instead of updating each lesson's answer targets consecutively

target_schedule.pool_order: Original frozen manifest rows in order, training rows only, then ascending answer position including STOP
target_schedule.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed + 81000); sequential permutation(212) once per epoch
target_schedule.actual_orders: Frozen schedules.npz int64 arrays, shape [128, 212], indexed by seed

optimizer: Unmodified original P030 Model.step: float32 parameters and moments, Adam lr .003, beta1 .9, beta2 .999, eps 1e-8, global gradient clip 1, original per-element birth ages
initialization: Load each seed's full original control initial-state.npz; compare p/m/v/birth/t/growth_rng and all metadata/counters exactly with the frozen control and original new_student(seed). No warm start or discarded fitting
primary_diagnosis: Final epoch128 train whole_correct and address_correct, per seed and paired differences against fixed sequential control; report every seed
strong_fit_gate: For each seed, final train whole_correct == 12 AND train address_correct == 12; all-three gate requires every seed
stability: Report epoch96 and epoch128 train whole/address scores and their fixed-control paired differences; no checkpoint selection
control_evidence: Reuse fixed original-order results and the verified Codex Windows replication. The replication is not new independent scientific evidence; do not retrain the control
execution_order: All three fixed primary trajectories, then all three complete target-by-target replays, then offline evaluation of all 18 rows at all 18 checkpoints
replay: Exact per-target prediction/loss/full-state digest/target metadata/counters and direct full checkpoint/final p,m,v,birth,t,RNG,events,counter comparison
heldout_policy: All six heldout combinations have already been viewed; report all checkpoint results as exposed diagnostics, never as a new blind test. No heldout training or score-based decisions
student_interface: Original raw binary Q plus true answer prefix; target only passed to Model.step loss side. No parser/row/width/address/profile metadata in forward or generate
stop: Exactly 128 epochs for all three seeds. No early stop, extension, extra seeds, best checkpoint selection, retries or parameter changes
cost_reporting: Equal training dense MAC only. Count primary/replay training, checkpoint and offline inference MAC/calls, p/m/v/birth bytes, elapsed walltime separately
scope: Single fixed-model target update-order diagnostic for legal UR1 ACK response fitting; not proof of causal failure mechanism, blind generalization, notification benefit, physical growth, ordinary-frame discrimination or semantic grounding
